# Bengaluru Sreehatta Sammelani (BSS)

BSS is a socio-cultural association centred around the Sylheti community in Bengaluru. BSS was founded in 2005 and celebrated its first Durgotsav in 2019.

## BSS Durga Puja 2026
- Dates: 16–21 October 2026
- Venue: The Occasion Bengaluru, Sri Devi Anugraha, Anup Layout, Basi Reddy Garden, KR Puram Road, Hoodi, Bengaluru, Karnataka 560048
- Organiser: Bengaluru Sreehatta Sammelani
- Phone / WhatsApp: +91 77950 83618
- Official site: https://bssbangalore.com/
- Schedule: https://bssbangalore.com/durga-puja-2026-schedule-timings/
- Directions: https://bssbangalore.com/how-to-reach-bss-durga-puja/
- Archives: https://bssbangalore.com/archive.html

Visitors from all communities are welcome. Programme details may change; use the official website for current information.
